title: Enaria
description: A modpack made with friendly server experience in mind !
body:
**Enaria** is a **friendly server experience** modpack, you will find **multiple quality of life** mods like _"Lighty", "Chat Heads", "Boat Item View", etc..._

This modpack shoulb be **relatively stable** containing base stability **performance** mods as of _"Sodium", "Lithium", "Noisium"..._

As for the **atmosphere** within minecraft isn't great that's why _"Sounds"_, _"Resonance"_, _"Particular"_, _"Pretty rain"_, _"Iris" (With already downloaded shaders)_ will make **your game looks and sounds great.** You can even **add your own shader/resource pack** within the game with the help of "Resourcify"

The only problem would be **no litematica?**... Well it's not **actually**, even neoforge got a port of it, say hi to _"Forgematica"_

**As for the friendly server part ? **The **map is already configured** to not be as advantageous has it could be, same thing for the **Freecam which collide with solid block**.

Here's what my take about a **friendly server modpack** is, _hope you enjoy it_.
